title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
raw_text: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections. psycopg2.OperationalError: FATAL: sorry, too many clients already
root_cause: The user-service failed to release database connections properly during a traffic spike, exhausting the connection pool limits set in pgbouncer.
resolution_steps: Increase max_client_conn in pgbouncer temporarily.
Restart user-service pods to clear dead connections.
Fix connection leak in UserProfileRepository.getUser() method.

title: Redis Cache Timeout
raw_text: TimeoutError: Redis connection to redis-cluster.internal:6379 timed out after 3000ms. GET session:9842a2
root_cause: Network partition between auth-service and the Redis cluster in eu-west-1 zone caused session validation to hang.
resolution_steps: Failover Redis to secondary node in eu-west-2.
Lower Redis timeout in auth-service from 3s to 1s to prevent cascading failures.

title: OOMKilled API Pods
raw_text: State: Terminated, Reason: OOMKilled, Exit Code: 137, Message: pod payment-processor-6b7df-z2x out of memory
root_cause: A large batch processing job loaded 500k rows into memory without pagination, exceeding the 2GB container limit.
resolution_steps: Bump memory limit to 4GB in deployment manifest to restore service.
Rewrite bulk-invoice processor to use stream reading (yield) instead of loading all rows into RAM.

title: Deployment Missing ConfigMap
root_cause: A helm deployment updated the deployment manifest but the corresponding ConfigMap was not pushed to the cluster first.
resolution_steps: Manually apply the missing ConfigMap using kubectl.
Update CI/CD pipeline to ensure ConfigMaps are applied before Deployments.

title: JWT Signature Verification Failed
raw_text: 401 Unauthorized - Exception: jwt.exceptions.InvalidSignatureError: Signature verification failed
root_cause: The JWT signing key was rotated in the auth-service, but the API gateway was still using the cached old public key to verify tokens.
resolution_steps: Restart API gateway to force a fetch of the new JWKS public keys.
Implement a background worker in gateway to refresh keys every 5 minutes.

title: Disk Space Full on Kafka Broker
raw_text: java.io.IOException: No space left on device at sun.nio.ch.FileDispatcherImpl.write0
root_cause: Retention policies on a new high-throughput topic were set to 7 days instead of 24 hours, filling up the broker's attached EBS volume.
resolution_steps: Expand EBS volume size on Kafka brokers via AWS console.
Alter topic configuration to reduce retention.ms to 86400000 (24h).

title: Null Pointer Exception in Checkout
raw_text: java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "DiscountCode.getAmount()" because "discount" is null in CartService.calculateTotal
root_cause: A missing null check for an optional discount field during checkout caused the entire cart calculation to fail for users without promo codes.
resolution_steps: Rollback checkout-service to previous version (v1.2.4).
Add Optional<DiscountCode> handling and null checks in CartService.java.

title: Deadlock in Order Processing
raw_text: ERROR 1213 (40001): Deadlock found when trying to get lock; try restarting transaction
root_cause: Two concurrent transactions attempted to update the same rows in the 'orders' and 'inventory' tables in opposite order.
resolution_steps: Application automatically retried and succeeded for most requests.
Update application code to always acquire locks in the same table order (orders then inventory).

title: 502 Bad Gateway to Third-Party Provider
raw_text: upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: connection failure to FedEx API
root_cause: The external FedEx API underwent unannounced maintenance, causing upstream connection resets.
resolution_steps: Disable FedEx shipping option in the frontend temporarily.
Route all orders to UPS integration.
Implement circuit breaker pattern for external shipping providers.
